title: Provider-neutral agent runner + dsh adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral agent-runner seam: a `CommandRunner`/`AgentRunner` trait pair with a real process runner and in-memory fakes, plus the first concrete adapter (`dsh`) that drives a headless coding agent over stdin/stdout JSON events. The adapter brackets each run with git status/head/branch probes to reject dirty trees, detect forbidden commits or checkouts, and collect changed files, and it turns a `QUESTION:` line in the final message into a `job-blocked` journal event. A neutrality test guards the shared module against naming any agent or model vendor.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.subtitle: Payload::JobBlocked
nodes.summary: Append-only event log. Gains a `JobBlocked` payload carrying the job, work item, cause and the agent's question, so a clarification is a first-class recorded event.

nodes.label: Reviewer env allow-list
nodes.subtitle: RUN_ENV_VARS
nodes.summary: The platform run variables a reviewer may inherit. Widened to `pub(crate)` so the dsh adapter can reuse the same allow-list when building the minimal git environment.

nodes.label: AgentRunner / CommandRunner
nodes.subtitle: traits + plain data
nodes.summary: The provider-neutral seam: `CommandRunner` runs one `CommandSpec`; `AgentRunner` runs one `AgentTask` through a runner and reports `AgentCapabilities`. Also holds the shared prompt rules, `build_prompt`, `question_line`, and the serializable result types.

nodes.label: RealCommandRunner
nodes.subtitle: child process, bounded
nodes.summary: Spawns the child with a cleared environment, its own process group, piped stdio and a default one-hour deadline; kills the whole tree on timeout and returns captured stdout/stderr and exit code.

nodes.label: DshAgentRunner
nodes.subtitle: dsh --profile headless --json -
nodes.summary: The first concrete adapter. Validates the task, brackets the run with git probes, feeds the prompt on stdin, parses newline-delimited JSON events, enforces the no-commit/no-checkout rules, and maps a `QUESTION:` line to `AgentOutcome::Asked`.

nodes.label: parse_events
nodes.subtitle: JSONL → Parsed
nodes.summary: Reduces the run's JSONL events to session id, final message, summed token usage and the first non-`completed` turn failure. A non-JSON line is an error naming its line number.

nodes.label: git probe commands
nodes.subtitle: status / head / branch
nodes.summary: Builds the `git status --porcelain=v1 -z`, `rev-parse HEAD` and `rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` commands with the minimal git environment, and parses their output into changed files, head commit and branch.

nodes.label: capability probes
nodes.subtitle: version / help / dump-config
nodes.summary: Probes `--version`, the headless `--help` and the profile `--dump-config` to state, rather than assume, what the harness supports — including whether a stop hook checks messages.

nodes.label: FakeRunner / FakeAgentRunner
nodes.subtitle: scripted doubles
nodes.summary: In-memory doubles that replay scripted answers and record every command and task, so the seam and the adapter can be exercised without starting a process.

nodes.label: neutrality test
nodes.subtitle: no agent/vendor names
nodes.summary: Scans the provider-neutral folder for agent names, container words and model-vendor names, and proves the scanner can fail by finding them in the concrete adapter.

nodes.label: dsh
nodes.subtitle: headless coding agent
nodes.summary: The external coding agent. Runs one task headless, prints JSONL events, and reports no model name or cost figure.

nodes.label: git
nodes.subtitle: repository state
nodes.summary: The repository's own git, queried for status, head commit and branch before and after each run.

edges.label: implements
edges.summary: The adapter is written entirely against the neutral seam: it builds `CommandSpec`s and reads `CommandOutput`s, never starting a process itself.

edges.label: runner.run(spec)
edges.summary: Every command the adapter issues — the agent run and each git probe — goes through the injected `CommandRunner`.
The adapter hands the agent's stdout to `parse_events` and acts on the parsed result.
The adapter builds and runs the status/head/branch probes before and after the run.
`capabilities()` runs the version, help and dump-config probes.

edges.label: RUN_ENV_VARS
edges.summary: The minimal git environment is filtered from the adapter's env using the shared reviewer allow-list plus HOME and git author/committer names.

edges.label: JobBlocked
edges.summary: An `Asked` outcome becomes a `Payload::JobBlocked` event carrying the question.

edges.label: spawn
edges.summary: The real runner starts the dsh child with the prompt on stdin and captures its JSONL stdout.

edges.label: spawn
edges.summary: The real runner starts git for each probe command.

edges.label: implements
edges.summary: The fakes implement both traits so tests drive the seam without a process.

edges.label: scans
edges.summary: The test asserts the neutral folder names no agent or model vendor.
